sentences.zh: 它摇了摇头，发出一声嘶鸣。

sentences.en: Kristoff kept walking, ignoring him.
sentences.zh: 克斯托夫头也不回地继续赶路，不理它。

sentences.en: Sven charged ahead, passed Kristoff, and then stopped in front of him.
sentences.zh: 斯文猛冲上前，越过克斯托夫，然后停在了他面前。

sentences.en: He faced him and looked Kristoff directly in the eye. “What is it, buddy?” Kristoff asked.
sentences.zh: 它转过身面对他，直直地注视着克斯托夫的眼睛。「怎么了，老伙计？」克斯托夫问。

sentences.en: The reindeer nudged his antlers into Kristoff’s side. “Hey, watch it,” Kristoff said, annoyed. “What’s wrong with you?” Sven shook his head and wiggled his mouth. “I don’t understand you when you talk that way,” Kristoff told him.
sentences.zh: 那头驯鹿用鹿角轻轻顶了顶克斯托夫的身侧。「嘿，小心点，」克斯托夫恼火地说，「你这是怎么了？」斯文摇摇头，动了动嘴。「你那样叫我是听不懂的，」克斯托夫对它说。

sentences.en: In a flash, Sven bucked Kristoff and lifted him up with his antlers. “Hey!
sentences.zh: 电光石火间，斯文猛地一甩身，用鹿角把克斯托夫顶了起来。「嘿！

sentences.en: Stop it!” Kristoff shouted. “Put me down.” Sven dropped him straight into the snow, hard. “No, Sven,” Kristoff said. “We’re not going back.” Sven snorted his disapproval. “She’s with her true love.” Kristoff saw Sven’s doubt.
sentences.zh: 停下！」克斯托夫喊道，「放我下来。」斯文猛地把他摔进雪里，结结实实。「不，斯文，」克斯托夫说，「我们不回去了。」斯文喷着鼻息，表示不赞同。「她正和真爱在一起呢。」克斯托夫看出了斯文的怀疑。

sentences.en: He glanced back at the kingdom to make his point.
sentences.zh: 为了证明自己的话，他回头瞥了一眼王国。

sentences.en: But to his surprise, he saw a strange new storm swirling above the castle.
sentences.zh: 可令他吃惊的是，他看见城堡上空盘旋着一场诡异的新风暴。

sentences.en: He could see dark clouds forming, and more ice on the castle walls, putting it into an even deeper freeze. “Anna!” he cried.
sentences.zh: 他能看见乌云正在聚拢，城堡墙壁上又结起更多寒冰，把整座城冻得更深。「安娜！」他惊呼。

sentences.en: Instantly, Kristoff changed his course and took off running toward Arendelle.
sentences.zh: 克斯托夫立刻改变方向，撒腿朝阿伦黛尔奔去。

sentences.en: Sven scrambled and raced up behind him.
sentences.zh: 斯文也慌忙跟上，从后面疾追而来。

sentences.en: He ducked his head and lifted Kristoff with his antlers, then threw him onto his back.
sentences.zh: 它低下头，用鹿角把克斯托夫托起，随即甩到自己背上。

sentences.en: The duo raced down the hillside.
sentences.zh: 这一人一鹿沿着山坡飞驰而下。

sentences.en: Anna was curled up on the floor of the library.
sentences.zh: 安娜蜷缩在图书室的地上。

sentences.en: She had made it to the door but was now too weak to stand.
sentences.zh: 她已经挪到了门口，可如今虚弱得站不起来。

sentences.en: No one could hear her whispered cries for help.
sentences.zh: 没有人能听见她微弱的呼救声。

sentences.en: She was so cold—and her heart ached.
sentences.zh: 她冷极了——心口阵阵作痛。

sentences.en: At that moment, the door handle jiggled.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，门把手晃动了一下。

sentences.en: Anna was barely able to raise her head to see who it was.
sentences.zh: 安娜好不容易才抬起头，想看清来人是谁。

sentences.en: The lock clicked.
sentences.zh: 锁「咔嗒」一声开了。

sentences.en: Anna could see a carrot wedged into the keyhole.… Suddenly, the door flew open.
sentences.zh: 安娜看见钥匙孔里塞着一根胡萝卜……忽然，门猛地打开了。

sentences.en: It was Olaf!
sentences.zh: 是雪宝！

sentences.en: The snowman pulled his carrot nose out of the lock and put it back into the middle of his face.
sentences.zh: 雪人从锁里拔出他的胡萝卜鼻子，重新安回脸中央。

sentences.en: He was very proud of himself, but his happiness melted the moment he saw Anna. “Anna, no!” he called.
sentences.zh: 他对自己得意极了，可一看到安娜，那份高兴瞬间融化了。「安娜，不要！」他喊道。

sentences.en: He ran to the fireplace and struck a match.
sentences.zh: 他跑到壁炉前，划着了一根火柴。

sentences.en: In seconds there was a large, roaring fire. “Olaf,” Anna said. “Get away from there!” “Whoa!” Olaf exclaimed, taking in the sight and feel of the fire.
sentences.zh: 转眼间，一团熊熊大火燃起。「雪宝，」安娜说，「快离那儿远点！」「哇！」雪宝惊叹着，感受着那火光与热气。

sentences.en: He was a little scared, but he couldn’t resist the warmth coming from the fireplace. “So that’s heat,” he said. “I gotta say, I still like it!” He hurried over to Anna and brought her closer to the fire. “So, where’s Hans?
sentences.zh: 他有点害怕，却又抵挡不住壁炉传来的暖意。「原来这就是热啊，」他说，「我得说，我还是挺喜欢的！」他匆匆跑到安娜身边，把她挪近火堆。「那么，汉斯呢？」

sentences.en: What happened to your kiss?” “I was wrong about him,” Anna said. “It wasn’t true love.” Olaf didn’t want to believe it. “But we rode all the way here,” he said. “Please, Olaf,” Anna managed to say. “You can’t stay here.
sentences.zh: 你的吻怎么了？」「我当初看错他了，」安娜说，「那不是真爱。」雪宝不愿相信。「可我们一路赶来就是为了这个啊，」他说。「求你了，雪宝，」安娜勉强说道，「你不能待在这儿。」

sentences.en: You’ll melt.” “I’m not leaving until we find some other act of true love to save you,” Olaf said.
sentences.zh: 你会融化的。」「在找到别的真爱之举来救你之前，我是不会走的，」雪宝说。

sentences.en: He sat down next to Anna. “Got any ideas?” Anna sighed heavily. “I don’t even know what love is anymore.” “That’s okay,” Olaf said. “I do.” He sat up a little taller. “Love is putting someone else’s needs before yours—like, you know how Kristoff brought you back here to Hans and left you forever?” “Kristoff loves me?” Anna asked.
sentences.zh: 他在安娜身旁坐下。「想到什么办法了吗？」安娜重重地叹了口气。「我连爱是什么都不知道了。」「没关系，」雪宝说，「我知道。」他坐直了些，挺起身子。「爱就是把别人的需要放在自己前面——就像，你知道克斯托夫把你送回汉斯身边，就永远离开了你吗？」「克斯托夫爱我？」安娜问。

sentences.en: Her eyes widened.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛一下子睁大了。

sentences.en: Olaf nodded. “You really don’t know anything about love, do you?” Anna looked at Olaf.
sentences.zh: 雪宝点了点头。「你真是一点都不懂爱，对吧？」安娜望着雪宝。

sentences.en: He was dripping from head to toe! “Olaf, you’re melting!” she cried. “Some people are worth melting for,” he said.
sentences.zh: 他正从头到脚往下淌水！「雪宝，你在融化！」她喊道。「有些人，值得为TA融化，」他说。

sentences.en: His face was quickly losing its shape.
sentences.zh: 他的脸正迅速失去形状。

sentences.en: Olaf tried to push up his sagging head.
sentences.zh: 雪宝努力想把耷拉下来的脑袋撑起来。

sentences.en: He ran and sat behind Anna, trying to escape the fire’s heat. “Just maybe not right this second.” A window across the room blew open and a cold gust of wind swept through.
sentences.zh: 他跑过去坐在安娜身后，想躲开火的热气。「也许只是现在这一秒还不行。」房间那头的一扇窗户猛地被吹开，一股寒风席卷而入。

sentences.en: Anna shuddered.
sentences.zh: 安娜打了个寒颤。

sentences.en: Olaf ran to the window to shut it. “Don’t worry,” he said. “I’ve got it.
sentences.zh: 雪宝跑到窗边去关窗。「别担心，」他说，「我来关。」

sentences.en: We’re gonna get through…” He stopped talking and stared out the window.
sentences.zh: 我们一定能挺过去的……」他忽然不说话了，呆呆地盯着窗外。

sentences.en: He leaned forward and squinted at the horizon. “Hang on, just one second.
sentences.zh: 他探身向前，眯眼看向天边。「等等，就一秒钟。」

sentences.en: I’m getting something!” He reached through the open window and grabbed an icicle off the window ledge.
sentences.zh: 我看到什么了！」他伸出窗外，从窗台上抓下一根冰柱。

sentences.en: He flipped the icicle around and used it as a telescope. “Hey, Kristoff and Sven!” he shouted when he realized who was running toward the castle.
sentences.zh: 他把冰柱调转方向，当成望远镜用。「嘿，是克斯托夫和斯文！」当他认出朝城堡跑来的是谁时，喊了起来。

sentences.en: He turned to Anna excitedly. “They’re coming back this way!” “They are?” Anna asked.
sentences.zh: 他兴奋地转向安娜。「他们正往回走呢！」「真的吗？」安娜问。

sentences.en: She tried to stand up to see for herself. “Wow, he’s moving really fast!” Olaf said. “Huh, I guess I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 她想站起来亲眼看看。「哇，他跑得可真快！」雪宝说。「嗯，看来我错了。」

sentences.en: I guess Kristoff doesn’t love you enough to leave you behind.” “Help me up,” Anna said, struggling. “Please.” “No,” Olaf told her. “You need to stay by the fire and keep warm.” Anna was adamant. “I need to get to Kristoff.” “Why?” Olaf asked.
sentences.zh: 看来克斯托夫对你的爱，还没到肯把你扔下的程度。」「扶我起来，」安娜挣扎着说，「求你了。」「不行，」雪宝对她说，「你得待在火边保暖。」安娜十分坚决。「我得去见克斯托夫。」「为什么？」雪宝问。

sentences.en: Then he paused. “Oh, I know why!
sentences.zh: 接着他顿住了。「噢，我知道为什么了！」

sentences.en: There’s your act of true love right there, riding across the fjords like a valiant, pungent reindeer king!” He reached for Anna. “Come on!” Sheets of ice began to break through the library walls.
sentences.zh: 你的真爱之举就在那儿——像一位英勇又带着腥膻味儿的驯鹿国王，正驰过峡湾呢！」他伸手去拉安娜。「快起来！」一片片冰层开始冲破图书室的墙壁。

sentences.en: The cracks grew across the walls, and the room began to collapse.
sentences.zh: 裂缝在墙上蔓延开来，房间开始崩塌。

sentences.en: Anna and Olaf hurried out of the library just in time.
sentences.zh: 安娜和雪宝及时慌忙逃出了图书室。

sentences.en: Together, they struggled to make it through the hallway, dodging ice as it appeared in their path. “Back this way,” Olaf said, pulling Anna.
sentences.zh: 他们一起艰难地穿过走廊，躲闪着挡路的寒冰。「往这边退，」雪宝拉着安娜说。

sentences.en: But every path they tried was blocked by ice! “We’re trapped!” he shouted.
sentences.zh: 可他们试过的每条路都被冰封死了！「我们被困住了！」他喊道。

sentences.en: Anna spun around and spotted a way out.
sentences.zh: 安娜转身一转，发现了逃生之路。

sentences.en: She took Olaf’s hand and they made their way over to a window, broke the glass, and slid down an icy ramp.
sentences.zh: 她拉住雪宝的手，两人挪到一扇窗前，砸碎玻璃，顺着冰坡滑了下去。

sentences.en: Olaf picked up more snow as he went.
sentences.zh: 雪宝一路上又沾起了更多雪。

sentences.en: They landed safely outside the castle and took off toward Kristoff.
sentences.zh: 他们安全落在城堡外，随即朝克斯托夫奔去。

chapters.title: 第二十一章 · 暴雪将至
chapters.en:
The winds were picking up as the storm raged throughout Arendelle. The snow continued to fall, and the air was frigid. The ice blocks in the fjord were beginning to shift, which made walking on the frozen surface dangerous.

The snow hit Anna’s face hard, blinding her, but she and Olaf continued. She held her hand up to shield her eyes when she reached the shore. It broke her heart to see the fjord waters frozen into solid blocks and the ships turned on their sides.

“Kristoff!” she called out weakly. She couldn’t see him, but she knew he was coming over the fjord—and she knew he was her last chance for survival. The ice was still spreading through her heart, making her weaker and weaker. She was determined, but was losing strength with each step.

The snow was swirling wildly now, covering everything. “Whoa!” Olaf cried as the wind lifted him up and took him from Anna.

Not far away, but completely engulfed in the snowstorm, Kristoff was riding on Sven’s back, racing desperately toward Anna. As he passed over the fjord, a ship that was wedged in the thick ice in front of him began to shift and wobble. “Come on! Come on!” Kristoff urged Sven.

At that moment, the ice in front of Kristoff shifted again and caused the ship to drop, splintering the surface. Sven bravely jumped over the frigid waters and bucked his rider off to safety. Then the reindeer fell into the water.

“Sven!” Kristoff screamed. “Sven!”

With a mighty effort, Sven leaped out of the water and landed safely on a floating piece of ice. He nodded, signaling that he was all right.

“Good boy,” Kristoff called. He turned back to find Anna.

Hans was also out on the frozen fjord, struggling through the storm. He was pursuing Elsa, however—and he nearly had her. “Elsa!” he yelled loudly through the howling winds. “You can’t run from this!”

“Don’t try to stop me,” Elsa called back to him. “Just take care of my sister.”

“Your sister?” Hans laughed. “She returned from the mountain weak and cold. She said you froze her heart.”

Elsa gasped. “No!” She was overwhelmed by what her powers had done. Her worst fears had come true.

“I tried to save her,” Hans lied. “But it was too late. Her skin was ice. Her hair turned white. Your sister is dead because of you.”

Elsa dropped to her knees and put her head in her hands.

The storm stopped abruptly in response to Elsa’s overwhelming despair. The winds and the driving snow ceased, leaving snowflakes suspended in the air.

In the sudden stillness, Kristoff finally spotted Anna. She was clutching her chest and her skin was pale, almost white. Her strength was decreasing with each passing moment.

Barely able to speak, she uttered his name and fell to her knees. “Kristoff.”

“Anna! Anna!” Kristoff called desperately as he ran toward her.

In the quiet air, the people of Arendelle gathered at the shore, staring out at the frozen fjord. The view was finally clear, and they could see their queen kneeling on the ice, her head bowed. Prince Hans stood just behind her.
chapters.zh:
风暴席卷阿伦黛尔，风势越来越猛。

雪不停地下，空气刺骨般寒冷。

峡湾里的冰块开始移动，令在冰面上行走变得危险。

雪重重拍在安娜脸上，迷了她的眼，可她和雪宝仍继续前行。

她走到岸边时，抬起手遮挡眼睛。

看到峡湾的水冻成实心冰块、船只侧翻倒地，她心都碎了。「克斯托夫！」她虚弱地喊。

她看不见他，却知道他正越过峡湾赶来——也知道他是自己活下去的最后希望。

寒冰仍在她心间蔓延，让她越来越虚弱。

她心意已决，却每走一步都在流失力气。

此刻大雪狂乱地打着旋，吞没了一切。「哇！」雪宝惊叫，风把他卷起，从安娜身边带走了。

在不远处，尽管完全被暴雪吞没，克斯托夫正骑在斯文背上，拼命朝安娜飞奔。

当他越过峡湾时，前方冻在厚冰里的一艘船开始移动、摇晃起来。「快啊！

快啊！」克斯托夫催促着斯文。

就在这时，克斯托夫前方的冰面再次裂动，令那艘船骤然下坠，冰面碎裂开来。

斯文勇敢地跃过冰冷的水面，把背上的骑手甩到安全之处。

接着那头驯鹿掉进了水里。「斯文！」克斯托夫尖叫，「斯文！」斯文奋力一跃，冲出水面，稳稳落在一块浮冰上。

它点了点头，表示自己没事。「好样的，」克斯托夫喊道。

他转回身去寻找安娜。

汉斯也在冰冻的峡湾上，顶着风暴艰难前行。

不过，他追的是艾莎——而且几乎得手了。「艾莎！」他在呼啸的风中大声喊，「你逃不掉的！」「别想拦我，」艾莎回喊，「只要照顾好我妹妹就好。」「你妹妹？」汉斯笑了，「她从山上回来时又虚弱又冰冷。」

她说你冻住了她的心。」艾莎倒抽一口气。「不！」她被自己的力量所造成的后果击垮了。

她最深的恐惧成了现实。「我本想救她，」汉斯撒谎道，「但太迟了。」

她的皮肤变成了冰。

她的头发变成了白色。

你妹妹死了，都是因为你害的。」艾莎跪倒在地，双手掩面。

回应艾莎那无尽的绝望，风暴骤然停息。

狂风与飞雪皆止，雪花悬停在半空。

在这突如其来的寂静中，克斯托夫终于看见了安娜。

她紧捂着胸口，脸色苍白，近乎透明。

她的力气正一刻一刻地消逝。

她几乎说不出话，念出他的名字，跪倒在地。「克斯托夫。」「安娜！」

安娜！」克斯托夫一面朝她奔去，一面绝望地喊。

在静谧的空气里，阿伦黛尔的百姓聚在岸边，凝望着冰封的峡湾。

视野终于清晰，他们看见自己的女王跪在冰上，低着头。

汉斯就站在她身后。

chapters.title: 第二十二章 · 最后的抉择
chapters.en:
Though Anna could barely move, she lifted her head to see Kristoff coming toward her. But nearby, in the other direction, she suddenly caught sight of something else—something she could hardly believe. Was that her sister? Could Elsa also be out on the ice? Anna tried to focus.

Then she realized that Hans was standing over Elsa, who knelt on the ice, her face buried in her hands. Horrified, Anna watched as Hans drew his sword and raised it over her sister’s head. He was taking his time, almost smiling with anticipation.

Anna knew that kissing Kristoff was her last hope for survival, but she couldn’t bear to see Elsa in danger. With great difficulty, she turned away from Kristoff and moved toward her sister.

“Elsa!” she cried. With a final surge of energy, Anna lunged, using every remaining ounce of her strength. She threw herself in front of Elsa to block Hans’s blow. “NO!” she shouted.

In that instant, Anna’s entire body froze, turning into solid ice. Hans’s sword came down at full strength on her body. The sword shattered! Hans reacted in angry astonishment as jagged pieces of steel fell into the snow.

At the sound of the sword, Elsa turned…and saw Anna’s frozen body, one arm raised to shield her sister.

“Anna!” Elsa cried. She jumped up and threw her arms around her unseeing sister. “Oh, Anna,” she said, weeping. “No, please, no!” Elsa sobbed, hugging the frozen figure.

Behind her, Hans was fuming. He quickly picked up his broken sword and started to swing it at Elsa, but Kristoff ran at him just in time. He hit Hans right on the jaw and knocked him down. There would be no second blows for Hans.

Olaf ventured forward, looking up at the sisters. He was shocked to see Anna so still, without movement or life. “Anna?” he asked sadly. He stepped back as Elsa hugged her sister and cried.

Kristoff, Sven, and Olaf all bowed their heads. So did the dignitaries and citizens of Arendelle, watching from the shore. A somber silence fell over the kingdom.

Suddenly, as Elsa hugged her sister, drops of water began to form at the tips of Anna’s fingers. Then her arm began to bend. Anna was beginning to thaw!

“Anna!” Elsa exclaimed.

“Elsa…,” Anna murmured. She opened her eyes and smiled lovingly at her sister. Elsa laughed with joy.

“You sacrificed yourself for me?” Elsa asked in wonder.

Still weak, Anna replied simply, “I love you.”

Olaf gasped. “An act of true love will thaw a frozen heart,” he said. Anna’s sacrifice had saved her own life!

Elsa found herself turning Olaf’s words over in her mind as she slowly realized their full meaning. “Love will thaw.… Love. Of course!” she said. She hugged Anna again and laughed.

“Of course what?” Olaf asked. Elsa took a step back and raised her hands above her head, and the snow drifted back up to the sky! Next, the ground began to shake and move. The ice and snow began to melt. The fjord waters thawed and a boat rose, lifting Elsa and the others onto its deck. Soon all the boats in the fjord were returned to their upright positions. Elsa waved her arms one more time and revealed a sunny sky! The warmth of a summer’s day spread across the kingdom in one joyous moment.

All of Arendelle cheered!

“Hands down, this is the best day of my life!” Olaf exclaimed. But the snowman was again starting to melt. “And,” he added, “quite possibly the last.”

Elsa looked over at the dripping, sagging snowman. “Oh, Olaf,” she said kindly. “Hang on, little guy.” She waved a hand over Olaf and surrounded him with a swirl of cold air. Olaf quickly refroze and looked like himself again. Best of all, he now had a permanent little snow cloud above his head, to keep him from melting ever again.

“Ha!” he exclaimed. “How are we doing this?”

Hans climbed to his feet, still dazed from Kristoff’s punch, and turned to Anna. “B-but she froze your heart,” he stammered. He thought Anna had frozen to death back in the library.

“The only frozen heart around here is yours,” Anna replied fiercely. Then, with all her might, she punched him in the face. Hans fell backward into the water.

Anna grinned. She was feeling warmer already. She caught sight of Kristoff and grinned. Then she hugged Elsa again. The sisters held each other tight. Neither one wanted to let go.
chapters.zh:
安娜虽几乎动弹不得，仍抬起头，看见克斯托夫朝她走来。

可就在近旁的另一个方向，她忽然瞥见别的东西——一件她几乎不敢相信的事。

那是她姐姐吗？

艾莎也会在冰上吗？

安娜努力集中目光。

接着她看清：汉斯正居高临下地站在艾莎身旁，而艾莎跪在冰上，脸埋在双手里。

安娜惊恐地看着汉斯拔出剑，高高举在姐姐头顶。

他不慌不忙，几乎带着期待的笑意。

安娜知道，吻克斯托夫是自己活命的最后希望，可她不忍心看艾莎身处险境。

她费尽力气，转离克斯托夫，朝姐姐挪去。「艾莎！」她喊道。

安娜使出最后一股劲，用尽残存的每一分力气猛扑过去。

她扑到艾莎身前，挡住汉斯的一击。「不！」她大喊。

那一刻，安娜的整个身体冻住了，化作坚冰。

汉斯的剑用尽全力劈在她的身上。

剑，碎了！

碎裂的钢片落进雪里，汉斯又惊又怒。

听到剑碎的声音，艾莎转过身……看见安娜冻僵的身躯，一只手臂还举着，护着姐姐。「安娜！」艾莎哭喊。

她跳起身，双臂抱住失去知觉的妹妹。「噢，安娜，」她含泪说道，「不，求你了，不要！」艾莎抽泣着，紧抱那冰冷的身躯。

在她身后，汉斯气得发抖。

他慌忙拾起断剑，朝艾莎劈去，可克斯托夫及时冲上来。

他一拳正中汉斯的下巴，把他打倒在地。

汉斯没有机会再出第二击了。

雪宝壮着胆子走上前，仰头望着姐妹俩。

看到安娜一动不动、了无生气，他震惊了。「安娜？」他难过地问。

他退后几步，任由艾莎抱着妹妹哭泣。

克斯托夫、斯文和雪宝都低下了头。

在岸边观望的阿伦黛尔使节与百姓，也纷纷低头。

一片哀寂笼罩了王国。

忽然，就在艾莎抱着妹妹时，安娜指尖开始凝出水珠。

接着她的手臂开始弯动。

安娜开始解冻了！「安娜！」艾莎惊喜道。「艾莎……」安娜喃喃。

她睁开眼，朝姐姐露出了充满爱意的微笑。

艾莎欢喜地笑了。「你为了我牺牲了自己？」艾莎又惊又喜地问。

安娜仍很虚弱，只轻轻答道：「我爱你。」雪宝倒抽一口气。「真爱之举能融化冰冻的心，」他说。

安娜的牺牲，救了她自己的命！

艾莎不由得在心里反复琢磨雪宝的话，渐渐明白了其中的全部含义。「爱能融化……爱。」

当然！」她说。

她再次抱住安娜，笑了起来。「当然什么？」雪宝问。

艾莎后退一步，双手举过头顶，雪花竟纷纷飘回天上！

接着，大地开始震动、起伏。

冰雪开始消融。

峡湾的水融化了，一艘船浮起，把艾莎和众人托上甲板。

很快，峡湾里所有的船都恢复了正立的姿态。

艾莎再挥一挥手臂，露出了晴朗的天空！

夏日的暖意在这一刻欢欣地漫过整个王国。

阿伦黛尔上下一片欢呼！「绝对是，今天是我这辈子最棒的一天！」雪宝喊道。

可雪人又开始融化了。「而且，」他补充，「很可能也是最后一天。」艾莎看向那个正淌水、垮塌的雪人。「噢，雪宝，」她温柔地说，「撑住，小家伙。」她朝雪宝挥了挥手，用一团冷气将他包裹起来。

雪宝很快重新冻好，又恢复了原样。

最妙的是，他头顶现在有了一朵永久的小雪云，让他再也不会融化。「哈！」他惊叫，「这怎么回事？」汉斯挨了克斯托夫一拳，还晕乎乎地爬起来，转向安娜。「可、可她冻住了你的心啊，」他结巴道。

他以为安娜早在图书室里就冻死了。「这周围唯一冰冷的心，是你的，」安娜厉声答道。

接着，她用尽全身力气，一拳打在他的脸上。

汉斯仰面跌进水里。

安娜咧嘴笑了。

她已经觉得暖和多了。

她看见克斯托夫，笑了起来。

接着她又抱住了艾莎。

姐妹俩紧紧相拥。

谁也不愿松手

sentences.en: He thought Anna had frozen to death back in the library. “The only frozen heart around here is yours,” Anna replied fiercely.
sentences.zh: 他以为安娜早在图书室里就冻死了。「这周围唯一冰冷的心，是你的，」安娜厉声答道。

sentences.en: Then, with all her might, she punched him in the face.
sentences.zh: 接着，她用尽全身力气，一拳打在他的脸上。

sentences.en: Hans fell backward into the water.
sentences.zh: 汉斯仰面跌进水里。

sentences.en: Anna grinned.
sentences.zh: 安娜咧嘴笑了。

sentences.en: She was feeling warmer already.
sentences.zh: 她已经觉得暖和多了。

sentences.en: She caught sight of Kristoff and grinned.
sentences.zh: 她看见克斯托夫，笑了起来。

sentences.en: Then she hugged Elsa again.
sentences.zh: 接着她又抱住了艾莎。

sentences.en: The sisters held each other tight.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩紧紧相拥。

sentences.en: Neither one wanted to let go.
sentences.zh: 谁也不愿松手

chapters.title: 第二十三章 · 暖春归来
chapters.en:
Summer returned to Arendelle, and the waters in the fjord were full of boats moving cargo and people. Hans sat locked in a cage on the deck of a ship preparing to return to the Southern Isles.

“I’ll return this scoundrel to his country,” a dignitary told the royal handler. “We shall see what his twelve brothers think of his behavior!”

Nearby, Arendelle soldiers were leading the Duke and his two guards to their ship.

“This is unacceptable,” the Duke protested. “I am innocent! I’m a victim of fear. I demand to see the queen!”

“Oh, right,” the royal handler told him. “I have a message from the queen: ‘Arendelle will henceforth and forever no longer do business of any sort with Weaseltown.’”

“Weselton!” shouted the Duke. “It’s Weselton!”

In the village, Anna hurried through the streets, pulling a blindfolded Kristoff behind her. “Come on, come on,” she called to him.

Anna led Kristoff straight into people and almost slammed him into a pole. “You’re not a very good blindfold guide,” he told her. Finally, they stopped.

“Here we are!” Anna said. She pulled off Kristoff’s blindfold. Before them sat a beautiful new sled. “I owe you a sled!”

Kristoff was taken aback. “Are you serious?” he said. “No. I can’t accept this.”

Anna laughed. “You have to. No returns. Queen’s orders. She’s named you the official Arendelle ice master and deliverer.”

“That’s not a thing,” said Kristoff with a smile.

“Sure it is!” Anna said. “And it even has a cup holder. Do you like it?”

Kristoff hugged Anna. “Like it?” he asked. “I love it. I could kiss you!” Kristoff looked into Anna’s eyes and suddenly felt bashful. “I mean, I’d like to. May I? I mean, may we? Wait—what?”

Anna leaned over and gave Kristoff a quick kiss. “We may,” she said.

Kristoff smiled. Then he leaned in and kissed Anna right back. But this time it was a real kiss, sweet and romantic, and perfect for Anna.

Not far away, Olaf was happily enjoying the summer weather with the help of his little snow cloud. He held a big bouquet of flowers up to his nose and took a deep sniff. Suddenly, he sneezed—and his carrot nose shot off his face!

Sven was standing nearby, and with a quick movement of his head, the reindeer reached out and caught the carrot in his mouth. For a moment, it looked like Sven might chomp down on his favorite food. But instead, he gave the carrot back to Olaf, who happily popped the carrot back onto his face.

Just past Olaf, Anna saw something else that brought a smile to her face. The gates to the castle were wide open. Elsa stood in the courtyard. All around her, people were putting on ice skates. And the parts of the castle that had been destroyed earlier were now fully repaired—with ice!

“Are you ready?” Elsa was asking the crowd. She raised her arms, swirled them in the air, and created a beautiful ice rink!

Anna ran to her sister. “The gates are open,” she said. “I like it.”

Elsa put an arm around Anna. “Let’s never close them again.” Then, with a smile, she pulled Anna onto the ice so the two could skate around the rink, together at last.

Behind them, Sven ventured out onto the ice, too. But his skating didn’t come so easily. His legs slipped and twisted as he struggled to keep his balance. Anxious for his friend, Kristoff chased after Sven, awkwardly trying to keep him upright.

Last came Olaf, who slid over to Anna and Elsa. Together, they all skated happily across the ice. Summer—as well as love and happiness—had finally returned to Arendelle.

夏天回到了阿伦黛尔，峡湾的水面上满是运送货物与行人的船只。

汉斯被锁在笼子里，坐在一艘准备返回南方群岛的船的甲板上。「我会把这个无赖押送回他的国家，」一位使节对王室侍官说，「倒要看看他十二个哥哥会怎么看待他的行径！」不远处，阿伦黛尔的士兵正押着韦斯文顿�公爵和他的两名护卫走向他们的船。「这不可接受，」公爵抗议道，「我是清白的！」

我只是恐惧的受害者。

我要见女王！」「噢，对了，」王室侍官对他说，「女王有话带给你：『阿伦黛尔从此往后，永远不再与鼬鼠镇有任何往来。』」「韦斯文顿�！」公爵喊道，「是韦斯文顿�！」村子里，安娜匆匆穿过街道，身后拉着被蒙住眼睛的克斯托夫。「快点儿，快点儿，」她对他喊。

安娜领着克斯托夫直直撞上行人，差点把他撞到柱子上。「你这个蒙眼向导当得可不怎么样，」他对她说。

终于，他们停下了。「我们到了！」安娜说。

她摘下克斯托夫的眼罩。

他们面前停着一架漂亮的新雪橇。「我还欠你一架雪橇呢！」克斯托夫吃了一惊。「你是说真的？」他说，「不。」

这个我可不能收。」安娜笑了。「你必须收下。」

概不退换。

女王下的令。

她封你为阿伦黛尔官方采冰大师兼送货员。」「哪有这种职位，」克斯托夫笑着说。「当然有！」安娜说，「而且还带杯架呢。」

你喜欢吗？」克斯托夫抱住安娜。「喜欢？」他问，「我简直爱死了。」

我真想亲你一口！」克斯托夫望进安娜的眼睛，忽然害羞起来。「我是说，我很想亲。」

可以吗？

我是说，我们可以吗？

等等——什么？」安娜凑过去，在克斯托夫脸上飞快地亲了一下。「我们可以，」她说。

克斯托夫笑了。

接着他俯身，回吻了安娜。

但这一回，是一个真正的吻，甜蜜而浪漫，对安娜来说再完美不过。

不远处，雪宝正借着头顶的小雪云，快活地享受夏日天气。

他举起一大束花凑到鼻尖，深深嗅了一下。

忽然，他打了个喷嚏——胡萝卜鼻子竟从脸上飞了出去！

斯文就站在近旁，它脑袋一甩，伸出嘴稳稳叼住了那根胡萝卜。

有一瞬间，斯文像是要一口咬下这最爱的食物。

可它并没有，而是把胡萝卜还给了雪宝，雪宝开心地把胡萝卜重新安回脸上。

越过雪宝，安娜望见另一样东西，令她脸上泛起笑意。

城堡的大门敞开着。

艾莎站在庭院里。

她身旁，人们正换上溜冰鞋。

而城堡早先被毁的部分，如今已全部用冰修缮一新！「准备好了吗？」艾莎正问着人群。

她举起双臂，在空中旋了一圈，造出一座漂亮的溜冰场！

安娜跑到姐姐身边。「大门敞开着呢，」她说，「我喜欢。」艾莎搂住安娜。「我们再也不关上它了。」接着她笑着把安娜拉上冰面，姐妹俩终于能一起绕着冰场滑了。

她们身后，斯文也壮着胆子踏上了冰面。

可它滑得可没那么轻松。

它双腿打滑、扭作一团，努力想保持平衡。

克斯托夫担心朋友，追在斯文身后，笨手笨脚地想扶它站稳。

最后过来的是雪宝，他滑到安娜和艾莎身边。

他们一起，欢快地滑过冰面。

夏天——连同爱与欢乐——终于回到了阿伦黛尔。
